title: Canvas tool taxonomy - Mask / Paint / Composite groups and a floating Detect strip
description:
Agreed with the user in the MPI-424 brainstorm 2026-08-01. This lands FIRST: it is the frame every other canvas card mounts into, and building Adjust, Shapes, Paint or Composite before it means building each of them twice.

THE PROBLEM: the Mask group in the left toolbar (MpiHistoryTools IMAGE_TOOLS) is four buttons today - brush, points, text, detect - and three of those four are the same job with a different engine. Shapes and Adjust would make it six. Paint and Composite would add four more. The toolbar column grows without bound and the user cannot tell which buttons produce the same artifact.

THE STRUCTURE (user's own, not derived):
  Mask       [brush] [detect ->] [adjust] [shapes]
  Paint      [brush] [shapes]
  Composite  [mask comp] [paint comp]
Detect is a COLLAPSE BUTTON: clicking it opens a small vertical strip OUTSIDE the tool panel, next to the toolbar, holding points / text / auto (the old Detect). It dismisses itself on a timer while unhovered so it cannot sit there forever. No corner triangle, no long-press - the user rejected both explicitly.

WHAT THIS IS NOT: the three detect modes are NOT collapsed into one mode. They stay maskPoints / maskText / maskDetect in TOOL_OPTIONS_REGISTRY and in _MASK_TOOLS; only their PRESENTATION changes, from three stacked toolbar buttons to three entries in a floating strip. That keeps this card to tool-list defs plus one new component. An earlier draft of this design collapsed the modes themselves and was dropped as unnecessary work.

TWO ENGINES, SIX BUTTONS: Mask Brush and Paint Brush are ONE brush engine with two destinations (binary mask layers vs the RGBA paint layer); Mask Shapes and Paint Shapes are ONE shape gizmo with the same split. This card only declares the modes and the groups - the engines are extracted by MPI-375 (brush) and MPI-368 (gizmo), each of which now ships two mounts instead of one tool.

REVERSES A RECORDED DECISION: MpiHistoryTools.js carries the comment 'Shapes (MPI-368) joins this group; it does not become a switcher'. That was written when the family was four hand-picked methods. Update the comment with the new reasoning rather than leaving it contradicting the code.

--- PLANNED 2026-08-01, three decisions settled before any code ---
1. CLICKING DETECT OPENS THE STRIP AND ACTIVATES NOTHING. Whatever tool was active stays active until a method is picked, and the button keeps a fixed Detect icon rather than taking on the last-used method's identity.
2. PROMPTBOX RULE for the groups that do not exist yet: Paint KEEPS the box (paint -> mask -> detail is one operation, the MPI-372 logic), Composite does NOT (it ends at its own Apply and needs the column for its two slots). Recorded for MPI-375 and MPI-373; this card adds no dead branches for modes that do not exist.
3. ONLY WORKING TOOLS SHIP. This card delivers the Mask group as brush plus the Detect strip. Adjust, Shapes, Paint and Composite buttons arrive with their own cards - no greyed placeholders advertising unbuilt features. That shrinks this card to one new behaviour.
MECHANISM FOUND WHILE PLANNING: MpiPopup is ALREADY used in MpiHistoryTools for the rail's hover tooltip (portals to body, position right, triggerEl). The strip is that primitive with three buttons inside, so there is no new positioning code - but the tooltip and the strip anchor to the same spot on the same button, so the tooltip must be suppressed while the strip is open, and the strip must not be stored in _tip, which is destroyed on every hover. Plan: tasks/MPI-425/plan.md
acceptance: The Mask group in IMAGE_TOOLS reads: brush, plus a Detect collapse entry owning points / text / auto. No other group or button ships in this card
Clicking Detect opens a floating strip anchored right of the button and activates NOTHING; picking a method activates it exactly as the old toolbar button did
The strip dismisses on pick, on Escape, on any tool activation, and on an unhovered timer driven by ONE tunable constant; re-entering the strip or its button cancels the timer
The rail hover tooltip is suppressed for the collapse button while its strip is open - both anchor position:'right' off the same element and would overlap

The strip is its own instance, never stored in _tip (which is destroyed on every hover); after destroy() no popup remains in the DOM and no timer is live, with listeners collected in _unsubs per the component teardown contract
The three detect modes stay separate modes in TOOL_OPTIONS_REGISTRY and _MASK_TOOLS - presentation changes, plumbing does not
tests/mask-tool-registry.test.cjs is extended so a sub-mode declared in the collapse def but missing from _MASK_TOOLS or TOOL_OPTIONS_REGISTRY fails, negative-controlled in both directions
The PromptBox rule for the future Paint and Composite groups is recorded in docs, without adding dead branches for modes that do not exist yet
The MpiHistoryTools comment saying Shapes 'does not become a switcher' is updated to the new reasoning, and docs/masking.md records the taxonomy within its 200-line cap (trim first)
